COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 519 of 2022
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. B.C. Pandey, learned Senior 
Advocate assisted by Mr. Naman Kamboj, 
learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Y.C. Tiwari, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for 
respondent no. 2.
Learned counsels for the respondents 
pray for and are granted four weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavits. Learned counsel for 
the petitioner shall file rejoinder affidavit 
within two weeks’ thereafter. 
List this case after six weeks.
In the meantime, impugned orders
dated 20.09.2021 and 04.03.2022 shall 
remain stayed. It is further provided that 
parties shall maintain status quo qua 
property in question and no third party 
interest shall be created over the land in 
dispute. 
Stay application (IA No. 1 of 2022) 
stands disposed of.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 23.03.2022
Aswal
